name: this-week
title: People this week
subtitle: What needs a person, who is away, and the reviews and trials coming up

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Thresholds live in the settings table.
sections.sql: select item, issue, detail from v_attention order by issue, item

sections.title: Away in the next two weeks
sections.sql: select name, employer, department, leave_type, starts_on, ends_on from v_away order by starts_on

sections.title: Leave waiting for a decision
sections.sql: select name, manager, leave_type, starts_on, ends_on, days_waiting from v_leave_open order by requested_on

sections.title: Reviews due
sections.sql: select name, manager, kind, due_on, state from v_reviews where state <> 'booked' order by due_on

sections.title: Trials and probation
sections.sql: select name, kind, ends_on, days_left, reviewed from v_trials order by ends_on

name: compliance
title: Record checks
subtitle: The employment records checked against NZ and Australian rules. Sources in docs/compliance.md

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: select rule, item, finding from v_compliance order by rule, item

sections.title: Certifications and licences
sections.sql: select name, certification, expires_on, days_left, state from v_certs where state in ('expired','expiring') order by expires_on

sections.title: Australian information statements
sections.sql: select d.name, d.kind, d.due_from, (select max(given_on) from statements s where s.employee_id = d.employee_id and s.kind = d.kind) as last_given from v_statements_due d order by d.name, d.kind

sections.title: Policies not acknowledged
sections.sql: select policy, version, name, days_open from v_policy_gaps order by days_open desc

name: workforce
title: Workforce
subtitle: Headcount, turnover and the annual leave liability

sections.title: Headcount
sections.sql: select * from v_headcount order by employer, department

sections.title: Turnover, last twelve months
sections.sql: select * from v_turnover order by employer

sections.title: Annual leave balances
sections.sql: select name, employer, hours, weeks, as_at, large from v_balances where leave_type = 'annual' order by weeks desc

sections.title: Work anniversaries in the next 30 days
sections.sql: select name, department, anniversary, years from v_anniversaries order by anniversary
